content: GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) have demonstrated a significant reduction in cardiovascular risk among patients diagnosed with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and chronic kidney disease (CKD). However, additional studies are required to further elucidate the specific renal benefits associated with these agents. Current clinical guidelines suggest that GLP-1 RAs can be considered an appropriate therapeutic option for individuals with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 20 mL/min/1.73 m² or higher.
